newsitem.title: BOSNIA: First refugee bus from Sarajevo crosses over line.
newsitem.headline: First refugee bus from Sarajevo crosses over line.

text.p: The first bus taking Moslem refugees to vote in their former home districts in Saturday's elections has crossed into Serb-held territory without incident, witnesses said.
They said the bus carrying some 13 refugees was checked by Bosnian government police before heading towards Izbisno on the main road to Foca, one of 19 agreed "voters' routes".
All voters will have to show identity papers to be allowed to cross ethnic boundary lines.
Hundreds of thousands of refugees and displaced people are expected to travel on muddy, rough roads to the home towns they fled during the war.
Thousands of Serb refugees from Belgrade have already arrived in the Bosnian Serb Republic to vote, brought on trains through the night and forwarded to polling stations by bus.
